candidate_path_priority_framework_for_fu.note: This is proposal metadata only; independent freeze review must decide ranking semantics without gold tuning.

candidate_record_deduplication.output_semantics: one candidate evidence record plus sorted unique supporting path IDs

design_scope: Typed deterministic bounded navigation over persisted frozen operational graph edges

freeze_review_readiness_gates.evidence: 26 parent raw-byte checks over 25 distinct paths passed; every mandated scientific-integrity flag is false.
Exactly the 14 frozen node types and 15 of 22 frozen relations are used; no unsupported transition, graph edge, relation type, or node type is introduced.
Thirty unique typed rows are frozen-permitted and Phase 6A.1-safe; all 14 Vendor/Employee directions remain excluded, including AUDIT_EVENT_FOR_VENDOR.

Default deny, depth 3, simple paths, terminal event/GL states, explicit hub/payment-bank/GL_JOURNAL prohibitions, and four empty hub/gap node sets are machine-checked; no Vendor/Employee node is entered.

Every row requires an exact typed edge, explicit stored/current/next field provenance, cutoff eligibility, and deterministic full-neighbor enumeration; the persisted simulation has zero provenance/type/temporal violations.
Two canonical simulations agree on every fingerprint; totals and depth counts exactly match Phase 6A.1, p50/p95/p99/max remain 31/68/78/91, and cycle controls reconcile to 8,433.
Structural sequence coverage is exactly 76/76 overall, complete at every depth and anchor type, with zero exclusions and no gold evidence or retrieval metric.
Transition, 14-node, forbidden, 8+2 motif, 30-justification, and risk design objects are complete, and no HIGH residual risk remains.

multiplicity_and_budget_policy.enumeration: Enumerate every exact edge in deterministic target/provenance/edge order unless a separately frozen cap applies.

parent_hash_verification.duplicate_check_reason: The authoritative Phase 6A.1 main report is checked both against the prompt-pinned digest and through the Phase 6A.1 inventory.

path_state_model.context_anchor_exception: APPROVAL_EVENT or AUDIT_EVENT at depth 0 may take exactly one stored-direction owner transition at hop 1, then enter normal lifecycle state.
path_state_model.gl_anchor_exception: GL_ENTRY at depth 0 may take exactly one typed stored-direction source transition at hop 1, then enter normal lifecycle state.
path_state_model.path_identity: case_id + exact resolved root + ordered transition IDs + edge IDs + record IDs
path_state_model.reached_gl_rule: GL_ENTRY reached from a transaction is a terminal accounting consequence.
path_state_model.simple_path_invariant: record_id may appear at most once in one path

serialization_convention.json_separators: comma plus newline/indent; colon plus one space
serialization_convention.newline: LF with exactly one trailing newline
serialization_convention.other_array_order: explicit semantic parent order or explicitly documented stable key order

transition_class_definitions.BACKBONE: Exact transaction, component, allocation, purchase-lifecycle, or accounting-source connectivity. Continuation is allowed except when a reached GL consequence is terminal.
transition_class_definitions.CONTEXT: Exact local event-to-owner anchor exit allowed only as hop 1; after reaching the owner, normal lifecycle transitions may compose.
transition_class_definitions.RESTRICTED: A frozen edge direction recorded for audit but absent from the executable proposal because of hub or safety policy.
transition_class_definitions.SUPPORTING: Exact operational projection with explicit provenance that complements a more provenance-complete backbone route.
transition_class_definitions.TERMINAL_CONTEXT: Exact owner-to-event local evidence that terminates immediately.

transition_inclusion_rule: Underlying relation is one of the 22 frozen executable graph relations.
Source and target types exactly agree with the frozen relation registry.
Direction is frozen allowed and Phase 6A.1 classifies the exact relation as safely reversible where reverse is used.
Traversal creates no new fact and retains operational provenance.
Source, target, edge, and provenance-effective temporal eligibility remain enforceable.
Vendor and Employee hub controls are not violated.
No benchmark label, gold evidence, retrieval metric, failure class, or RCA concept justifies the transition.
The transition has ordinary operational financial semantics.
